limitations: Three-run medians are not confidence intervals or guarantees for other hardware/workloads.
Chromium on the development machine; basic WebGL is forced, not physical old-GPU validation.
Paint fences and pan intervals include browser scheduling; they do not isolate GPU execution time.
Heap is main-thread JS heap after exposed GC, not total browser/worker/native/GPU memory.
Point warm-pan maxima still contain approximately one-second intervals; not hitch-free playback.
No fresh Canvas/PixiJS performance comparison in this record; compare only against 315c5c8.
Vertex-heavy baseline attempts did not finish within the 120-second whole-process budget; no baseline app-stage timing, median or speedup ratio is claimed for that fixture.
Appearance patches are localized; changed symbol text/size/priority or source topology requires safe layout/rebuild.
